picks.title: Autodesk Adds AI and 3DGS Tools Across Maya, 3ds Max and More
picks.headline: Autodesk Adds AI and 3DGS Tools Across Maya, 3ds Max and More
picks.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 Autodesk added a 'Bring Your Own Data' feature to Maya's MotionMaker, letting studios train custom generative motion models on their own rigs and mocap, plus editable 3D Gaussian splats in 3ds Max for folding AI-captured environments into shots. A craft-level shift in how animators and VFX artists generate and edit performance and scenes.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability: a concrete Maya/3ds Max release (BYOD generative motion models + editable 3DGS) that changes how animators and VFX artists work tomorrow; novel SIGGRAPH 2026 announcement from a credible post-production outlet.

picks.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?
picks.headline: Is this the future of filmmaking?
picks.excerpt: Damian Allen walks through a hybrid AI film-set approach built on Beeble's SwitchLight, where AI transforms backgrounds and relighting while real actor performances and camera work are preserved -- a middle ground between traditional production and fully synthetic generation. A hands-on read on how AI relighting reshapes the on-set and post workflow.
picks.rationale: Hands-on workflow read on a hybrid AI set (SwitchLight relighting over real performance) that directly informs on-set and post decisions; distinct URL and content from the earlier stale SwitchLight 3.0 launch item.
